_comment: ARC mainnet (5042). RadarDex i ArcPad: adresy + topics z oficjalnych docsow (topic0 zweryfikowany keccakiem). Warp: adresy z bundla JS circlewarp.fun; topic0 policzony z kodu w docs (indeksacja argow do potwierdzenia na pierwszym launchu - patrz README); buy idzie na kontrakt BondingCurve z eventu (curve_arg_index). UniswapV3 = generyczny catch-all (lapie tez Tolly i wszystko inne co otwiera pool na kanonicznym V3).

pads.name: RadarDexV1
pads._comment: legacy - nowe launche ida przez V2

pads.name: ArcPad
pads._note: anti-snipe: pierwsze 1200 blokow max 2% supply na portfel

pads.name: Warp
pads._note: topic0 i sygnatury buy/sell ZWERYFIKUJ na pierwszym mainnetowym launchu (arc-scan.org -> tx -> Logs/calldata); WarpDex router do handlu po graduacji

pads.name: ArcToolsPad
pads._comment: Nasz wlasny launchpad (arctools.fun/launchpad). Trading na kontrakcie launchpada: buy(token,minOut) payable USDC, sell(token,amount,minOut).

pads.name: ArcToolsPad v3
pads._comment: ArcToolsPad v3: pary z dowolnym tokenem + graduacja. buy(token,minOut) payable dziala tylko dla par USDC (native); tokeny w parze ERC-20 -> buyToken(token,quoteIn,minOut) po approve (TODO w sniperze). Graduowane tokeny handluja na Uniswap V3 (pula kanoniczna).

pads.name: UniswapV3
pads._note: catch-all: kazdy nowy pool na kanonicznym V3 (w tym launche Tolly)

pads.name: Archemist
pads._comment: archemist.fun v2-usdc: direct Uniswap V3 launch (fee 10000), LP locked in PositionLocker. Event: token idx1, creator idx2, pool idx3.

pads.name: Arguspad
pads._comment: arguspad.io: Uniswap V4 pool with Argus hook 0xa368005a…; PoolKey taken from Initialize in the launch tx.

pads.name: Arguspad V3
pads._comment: arguspad.io direct-V3 mode (dyor-api factory): TokenCreated(token idx1, deployer idx2, v3factory idx3); canonical V3 pool fee 10000, LP position locked. API: arc-api-production-ef9c.up.railway.app/api/tokens

pads.name: act.fun
pads._comment: actfun.pro: TokenRegistered(token idx1, creator idx2, fee) on the act.fun fee manager; trading on Uniswap V4 (PoolKey via resolver).

pads.name: UniswapV4
pads._comment: generic Uniswap V4 venue for manual buys (auto_pad) — no launch watching (PoolManager Initialize is chain-wide; the Insider index covers it).

pads.name: long.supply
pads._comment: long.supply launches: Uniswap V3 pools quoted in a wrapped stock (CRCL/NVDA/...). Buys/sells go USDC -> stock -> token via SwapRouter02.exactInput; the hop (mid token + tiers) comes from the ArcTools route API (auto_pad).
